title: Add your data
intro: Choose the zip file you downloaded from a platform, a folder, or single files. Everything is read and kept on this computer only.
introFor: Choose the zip file or folder you downloaded from {{name}}. We only open what belongs to your {{name}} export, and everything is read and kept on this computer only.
failed: Something went wrong while reading this. Nothing was stored.

step.importers: Looking for familiar things in it…

problem.no-fit: This doesn't look like a {{name}} export, so we didn't add it. Please choose the zip file or folder you downloaded from {{name}}.
problem.too-many-files: There are too many files here for us to look through. Please choose the {{name}} export itself: the zip file or folder you downloaded. Nothing was stored.
problem.too-many-candidates: We found too many files here that could be your {{name}} export. Please choose the export itself: the zip file or folder you downloaded. Nothing was stored.
problem.too-big: This is too large to read in your browser, so nothing was stored. If you can, make a new {{name}} export with only the data the study asks for.

choose.title: We found more than one {{name}} export
choose.one: Which one should we add? Only the one you choose is read.
choose.several: Which ones should we add? If your export came in several parts, choose all of them. Only what you choose is read.
